resolutions.researcher_notes: DEAD_LINK for Status=cancelled. The current_ref is an archived screenshot of a 2019-01-08 Fangchenggang municipal air-quality bulletin ('防城港市环境空气质量优良率连续四年') that never mentions a gas pipeline and cannot attest to any status -- and it is dated 2019, three years before this row's own ProposalYear=2022, so it could not document a cancellation of a not-yet-proposed project even if it were on-topic (this repeats the row shard's own critical-deep-sweep finding at batches/china-guangxi-gas/staging/deepsweep-pilot/rows/P4720.json; url_verifier's substring pass on this URL is a false positive off the archive.org page's metadata description tag, not the actual screenshot content). I searched (Chinese, targeted at 钦州-防城港 天然气管道 2022/取消/核准) for any independent source specifically reporting a 2022-proposed-then-cancelled Qinzhou-Fangchenggang gas line and found none. What I did find is an independent, non-GEM 2011 EIA public notice (ihouse.ifeng.com) documenting a same-named, same-length (70.44km) '防城港支线' of the Guangxi/Beihai LNG transport network as a planned item as far back as 2011 -- i.e. evidence pointing toward this branch being real infrastructure with a much earlier planning history, not a 2022 proposal that was cancelled. This disagrees with (does not support) the recorded Status=cancelled/ProposalYear=2022 combination, so per instructions I am not proposing a ref for a different value here -- flagging UNRESOLVED and deferring to Update workflow, consistent with the row shard's own 'unclear/route to Update' verdict.
